items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: there was another piano player by the name of -- they used to call him Two Ton Baker, and he could play all the Ellington things on piano, you know.

ctx.x: And -- oh, it was a cute thing, when my parents used to watch me, when I was supposed to be studying my homework, my lessons, but there was a disc jockey in Chicago called Bob Hawk, and he used to play Ellington all day and all night. And there was another piano player by the name of -- they used to call him Two Ton Baker, and he could play all the Ellington things on piano, you know. And I would go into a haze when I'd hear those things on the air, and so my parents would follow me right straight to the theater.…
